scope: FIRST_SHARD_ONLY metadata inventory, not full source cohort, English/quality/rights/tokens/admissions.

schema.duplicate_JSON_keys: Explicit whole-record hold before any parsed-field use, nested keys included.
schema.unknown_or_bad_rows: Every complete physical line retained as ordinal/offset/length/LF/rawSHA/flags even if malformed, duplicate-key or oversized; never silently skip.
schema.oversized: Consume/hash entire line in fixed chunks without parsing; mid-line cap produces only prefix hash explicitly not whole-line hash.

storage: Append-only records SQLite no text copy; exact scalar fields up to4096UTF8B, otherwise overflow hold+rawline backing; compact text SHA/bytes/chars, rawlicense evidence, conservative derived family leads.
exception_storage: At most12MB schema-only exception JSONL with ordered bytes/SHA and counts; flags/counters preserve family/license/date uncertainty without serializing allnormal metadata twice.
atomicity: Append-only batches100; PRAGMA max_page_count112MB, synchronousFULL DELETE rollback journal,4MBcache. Prewrite conservative rowgrowth+8MB journal/terminal reservation and128MB aggregate guard; any stop preserves only committed prefix and partial counters. No resume/retry.
source: Existing publisher hash+independent receipt/stat. Readonce O_RDONLY/NOFOLLOW, full compressedSHA and every gzip memberCRC/EOF/trailing check before COMPLETE.
known_hold: Exact first record id/rawlineSHA/textSHA and parent whole-review bound; KNOWN_REVIEW_HOLD must persist.
